Introduction

This week, I was able to add some per-season maps, add some consistency plots, look at the scatter plot by urbanicity quartile, and trim the code file into a separate file for easy use.

Data Loading

d = readRDS("../report_data_cache.rds")
list2env(d, envir = .GlobalEnv)
## <environment: R_GlobalEnv>
lower48 = setdiff(c(state.name, "District of Columbia"), c("Alaska", "Hawaii"))

cat("Filtered rows:", nrow(diff_peak_filtered), "\n")
## Filtered rows: 1947
poster_theme =
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18), # for facets
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 40)
  )

Time

diff_peak_time = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(!is.na(centroid_time_diff) & !is.na(signed_lag))

diff_peak_time_zoom = diff_peak_time |>
    filter(signed_lag >= -10, signed_lag <= 10, centroid_time_diff >=
        -10, centroid_time_diff <= 10)

centroid_lm_zoom = lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_time_zoom)

diff_peak_time_zoom$pred <- predict(centroid_lm_zoom, newdata = diff_peak_time_zoom)

timing = ggplot(diff_peak_time_zoom, aes(x = signed_lag, y = centroid_time_diff,
    fill = as.factor(peak_window))) + geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black",
    size = 2, stroke = 0.8) + geom_line(color = "black", aes(y = pred),
    lwd = 1.2) + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~peak_window, labeller = labeller(peak_window = c(`1` = "Window 1",
    `2` = "Window 2", `3` = "Window 3"))) + labs(x = "DTW signed lag",
    y = "True timing lag (centroid)") + poster_theme + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("timing.png", dpi = 600, width = 12, height = 6)

Magnitude

diff_peak_mag = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, frechet <
        25, truth_mag_ratio < 5)  #, dtw_rmse < 5)

mag = ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = as.factor(peak_window)), pch = 21,
        color = "black", size = 3, stroke = 0.8) + geom_smooth(method = "lm",
    color = "black", lwd = 1.2, se = FALSE) + facet_wrap(~peak_window,
    labeller = labeller(peak_window = c(`1` = "Window 1", `2` = "Window 2",
        `3` = "Window 3"))) + theme_bw() + labs(x = "Fréchet distance",
    y = "True magnitude ratio", fill = "Peak window", color = "Peak window") +
    poster_theme + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("mag.png", dpi = 600, width = 12, height = 6)

Local Texas comparisons

hsa_state = read.csv("../hsa_state_inc.csv")
source("../metric_functions.R")
source("../graphstat_functions.R")
source("../write_dtw.R")
hsa_id = 405
hsa = hsa_state[hsa_state$hsa_nci_id == hsa_id, ]

P = as.matrix(hsa$inc_hsa)
Q = as.matrix(hsa$inc_state)

res_dtw = dtw_distance(P, Q)

res = discrete_frechet(P, Q)


# dtw adjusted
P_warped = rep(NA, length(Q))
i = res_dtw$path[, 1]
j = res_dtw$path[, 2]
P_warped[j] = P[i]
# P_warped = na.approx(P_warped, rule = 2)

df_plot = data.frame(index = seq_len(length(Q)), HSA_aligned = P_warped,
    State = Q)

normal = ggplot(hsa) + geom_line(linewidth = 1, aes(x = seq_len(148),
    y = inc_hsa, color = "HSA")) + geom_line(linewidth = 1, aes(x = seq_len(148),
    y = inc_state, color = "State")) + labs(x = "Weeks (since 2022 Week 39)",
    y = "% of ED visits", title = paste0("Local vs. State (Amarillo)")) +
    theme_minimal() + poster_theme + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22,
    face = "bold")) + scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c(HSA = "blue",
    State = "red"))

warped = ggplot(df_plot) + geom_line(aes(x = index, y = HSA_aligned,
    color = "HSA"), linewidth = 1) + geom_line(aes(x = index,
    y = State, color = "State"), linewidth = 1) + labs(x = "Weeks (since 2022 Week 39)",
    y = "% of ED visits", title = paste0("DTW-warped Local vs. State (Amarillo)")) +
    theme_minimal() + poster_theme + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22,
    face = "bold")) + scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c(HSA = "blue",
    State = "red"))

(normal/warped)

ggsave("amarillo.png", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 10)

US Maps

win_labels = c(`1` = "Window 1", `2` = "Window 2", `3` = "Window 3")

# Per-window: raw metric averages (correlations would have
# only 1 row per group)
hsa_window_vals = diff_peak_filtered %>%
    group_by(ID, state, peak_window) %>%
    summarise(mean_signed_lag = mean(signed_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_frechet = mean(frechet, na.rm = TRUE), mean_mag_ratio = mean(truth_mag_ratio,
            na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

us_map_window = us_map %>%
    filter(state %in% lower48) %>%
    crossing(peak_window = c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
    left_join(hsa_window_vals %>%
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID), by = c("hsa_nci_id", "state",
        "peak_window"))

seasonal_map = function(data, fill_var, title, limits, fill_scale) {
    ggplot() + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(data),
        "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = .data[[fill_var]]), color = "gray20",
        linewidth = 0.1) + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(data),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
        fill_scale + facet_wrap(~peak_window, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(peak_window = win_labels)) +
        coord_sf() + theme_void() + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 20,
        face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 6)), legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.key.width = unit(0.7,
            "cm"), legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"), legend.position = "right",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
}
seasonal_map(us_map_window, "mean_signed_lag", title = NULL,
    limits = c(-1, 1), fill_scale = scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
        mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1,
            1), oob = scales::squish, na.value = "gray90", name = "Signed lag (days)"))

ggsave("timingmap.png", dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 12)
seasonal_map(us_map_window, "mean_frechet", title = NULL, limits = c(0,
    25), fill_scale = scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1,
    limits = c(0, 25), oob = scales::squish, na.value = "gray90",
    name = "Fréchet distance"))

ggsave("frechetmap.png", dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 12)
